question: The distance between the centers of two circles of radii 24 cm and 18 cm respectively is 48 cm. Find the length (in cm) of the transverse/indirect common tangent to both circles.
solution:
Formula used:

Indirect common tangent = √ (distance between the two centers2 - ( r1 + r2)2

Calculation: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5a8f7415d034e907ab0e16c2591db849e7759b03552d0051c81830dd1641b56.png] 

Indirect common tangent = d cm

As per the formula,

⇒ d= √ (482 - (24+ 18)2.

Square both sides

⇒ d2= (482 - (24+ 18)2.

⇒ d2 = 482 - 42²

⇒ d² = 90 × 6

⇒ d = 6√15

∴ The correct option is 1
